- Despite friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn felt Marilyn was still maintaining a professional distance at the bank, which disappointed her.
- Carolyn told Marilyn she felt there was a distance in their work dynamic. Marilyn said she hadn’t realized that, apologized if it seemed that way, and agreed they should talk about improving collaboration.
- After a private meeting with Marilyn, Carolyn believed they had cleared the air and better understood each other’s professional expectations and personal boundaries; she felt content and optimistic.
- Carolyn proposed teaming up on a new project proposal. Marilyn said it was a great idea, was glad they had talked, and looked forward to working more closely with Carolyn.
